scope: Full local API and web verification of the new feedback implementation

runtime.mailpit: /mailpit v1.31.2 compiled with go1.27.1 on linux/amd64

isolation.dataStorage: new tmpfs for both services, no existing volume attached

changes: Both capture suites still require every school table to have RLS enabled and forced, now require exactly 45 tables, and verify planning_defaults is among their exact text-array names.
The start-now contract expects the absent meeting point to remain empty; an invalid numeric meeting point still verifies schema rejection with HTTP 400.

planningDefaultsReview.method: Independent read-only static review plus the complete integration suite on isolated PostgreSQL 17.11.
planningDefaultsReview.finding: No certain defect identified in authorization, RLS, version concurrency, idempotence or commercial selection.
confirmedBySixSpecificTests: Personal preferences persist separately for each school member; learners and other schools are denied.
RLS prevents even an administrator from reading another member preferences.
Identical command replay keeps one receipt and audit; changed payload and stale version are rejected.
Concurrent updates to an existing preference yield one success and one version conflict; preferences can be cleared.
Planning, moving and immediate start accept an absent or empty meeting point while retaining commercial and instructor prerequisites.
Immediate start snapshots the compatible current preferred tariff and falls back when that tariff is disabled.
coverageLimits: No dedicated scenario for two concurrent first creations or forbidden direct RLS INSERT/UPDATE.
No dedicated scenario for a tariff superseded by a higher version or expired terms; the disabled-tariff branch is exercised.
No dedicated PUT or AP72 replay scenario after membership revocation; the revoked-member GET is exercised.
No physical-device GPS, battery or VoiceOver qualification is inferred from these server and web checks.
